description: Test oracle for the webcaltides legacy nodal path, generated by running it. See 2026-10-09-wct-nodal-cleanroom-spec.md.

fields.constituent: constituent name as keyed in the output
fields.year, month, day, hour: UTC calendar date and whole hour at which u and f are evaluated, before the shift (spec section 3)
fields.shift_hours: the station time-meridian shift m in hours; both evaluation instants move by +m hours (spec section 3)
fields.V0_raw: V0 in degrees as the legacy path emits it, NOT reduced modulo 360 (informational; do not match)
fields.u_raw: u in degrees as the legacy path emits it, NOT reduced modulo 360 (informational; do not match)
fields.V0_plus_u_mod360: (V0+u) reduced to [0,360) degrees: the value to match
fields.u_mod_pm180: u reduced to [-180,180) degrees: the value to match for u
